tower-of-hanoi.title: Recursive solve after placing largest
tower-of-hanoi.principle: After moving the largest disk that is not yet in its final position onto its goal peg, treat the remaining smaller disks as a subproblem and solve it recursively.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When a disk is the largest among those not yet correctly placed and its destination peg is known.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving a larger disk onto its goal peg before clearing smaller disks that will later need that peg, resulting in a deadlock.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Standard recursive transfer of k disks
tower-of-hanoi.principle: To move a stack of k disks from a source peg to a target peg using the third peg as auxiliary, first recursively move the top k‑1 disks to the auxiliary peg, then move the kth (largest) disk to the target, and finally recursively move the k‑1 disks from the auxiliary onto the target.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever you need to relocate an entire ordered stack of consecutive disks from one peg to another while preserving the order.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Attempting to move the bottom disk of a stack while smaller disks remain on top, which violates the top‑disk rule.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Output move list as final parseable block
tower-of-hanoi.principle: The final answer must be a single syntactically correct Python‑style list of moves; the verifier extracts the last such list from the response.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When writing the final answer, ensure the output is exactly a list like [[disk, from, to], ...] with matching brackets.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Including explanatory text before the list, causing the parser to miss the moves.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Verify final configuration before output
tower-of-hanoi.principle: After generating the move sequence, mentally replay each move from the initial state and confirm that the resulting arrangement matches the goal configuration before submitting the answer.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before finalizing the answer, after the move list is constructed.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Submitting a move list that leaves some disks on the wrong peg, so the final configuration does not match the target.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Provide only the move list, no extra text
tower-of-hanoi.principle: The response should contain only the move list; any additional characters, commentary, or formatting may interfere with the verifier's parsing.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: When producing the final answer, output just the list and nothing else.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Appending a comment after the move list, which the verifier treats as part of the answer and fails to parse.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Validate legality of each move
tower-of-hanoi.principle: Before adding a move, ensure the source peg’s top disk matches the moving disk and that the destination peg’s top disk (if any) is larger, so the move obeys the Tower of Hanoi rules.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: During construction of the move sequence, for every proposed move.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving disk 3 from a peg whose top disk is actually disk 2, violating the top‑disk rule.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Clear target peg of smaller disks before moving larger disk
tower-of-hanoi.principle: Never place a larger disk onto a peg that currently holds any smaller disk; first relocate those smaller disks to another peg.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever you intend to move a larger disk onto a peg, check that the peg is empty or its top disk is larger.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving disk 5 onto peg 2 while peg 2 still has disk 4 on top, which is smaller than disk 5.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Avoid moving small disks onto a peg that will later receive a larger disk
tower-of-hanoi.principle: Do not place a small disk onto a peg if a larger disk will later need to be placed on that same peg while the small disk remains there, as it will block the larger disk.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Before moving a small disk onto any peg, consider whether a larger disk will later be moved onto that peg.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Moving disk 1 onto peg 2, then later trying to move disk 3 onto peg 2, which is blocked because disk 1 is on top.

tower-of-hanoi.title: Move blocking smaller disks to any other peg before moving larger disk
tower-of-hanoi.principle: If a larger disk is not the topmost on its source peg, first relocate all smaller disks that sit above it to another peg before moving the larger disk.
tower-of-hanoi.when_to_apply: Whenever you need to move a disk that has smaller disks on top of it.
tower-of-hanoi.example: Attempting to move disk 4 while disks 1 and 2 remain stacked on top of it on the same peg.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model stops generation before outputting any moves, often due to token limit or misinterpreting the answer format.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Always generate at least one move and output the complete move list as a Python‑style list.

tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model runs out of tokens or cuts off the list early, leaving the sequence incomplete.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Plan the move sequence within the token budget and ensure the list is closed with a matching bracket before ending.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Attempted to move a disk that is not the topmost on its source peg
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model forgets to check the current top of the source peg before selecting a move.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Before adding a move, verify that the chosen disk is the topmost on its source peg.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Prematurely moving a small disk onto the final target peg, causing later moves to be impossible
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model places a small disk onto the goal peg without considering that a larger disk will later need to be placed there, blocking it.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Before moving a small disk onto the goal peg, ensure that no larger disk will later need to occupy that peg, or move the small disk elsewhere first.

tower-of-hanoi.description: Attempted to place a larger disk onto a smaller disk (illegal move)
tower-of-hanoi.why_it_happens: The model neglects the rule that larger disks cannot be placed on top of smaller ones.
tower-of-hanoi.how_to_avoid: Check the top disk of the destination peg; only place a disk onto an empty peg or onto a larger disk.
